about: Design 125 D4: SSIDs of access points that move (phones and tethering, cars, coaches, trains, dashcams, in-flight). Matched lowercase: `words` against the SSID split at every non-letter, `prefixes`/`suffixes`/`exact`/`contains` against the whole SSID, `first_words` against its first word. A car's default SSID (the BSSID's last three octets) is a rule in PlacesPlan.kt. Never stored, never logged.
